messages:
maria (devex): Quick heads-up — I'm proposing we land a small proxy shim in the Python + TS SDKs to inject the new X-Route-Policy header for the internal policy migration. Will be behind an opt-in flag initially. Want to align on rollout UX + console telemetry names.

sam (eng-platform): What exact header name are we standardizing? X-Route-Policy or X-Redwood-Route? Also need to confirm server will accept both for the migration window.

jia (eng): Backend will accept both for 2 weeks then start rejecting the old header. We should not surprise customers. If we add a shim, it must be clearly off by default and documented.

alex (devex): Agreed. Proposal: SDK flag env REDWOOD_SDK_SHIM=enabled / disabled, and a programmatic opt-in param `enableProxyShim: true` in TS. Default false.

leah (eng-platform): Telemetry ask: emit a sampled event `sdk.proxy_shim.opt_in` and a counter `sdk.proxy_shim.injected` (per request). Console team wants these names so they can wire a dashboard tile. Can we also add a tag with `route_policy_variant`?

maria (devex): yes to both. Let's keep metric names short: `sdk.proxy_shim.opt_in` and `sdk.proxy_shim.injected`. route_policy_variant values: `legacy`, `shimmed`, `explicit`.

sam (eng-platform): How will rollout UX look? We should show an in-console banner when >1% of an org's requests use shim (opt-in). Also allow per-org opt-out via console toggles.

alex (devex): For SDK docs, we'll add a short snippet and an example migration script. Example:

```bash
# enable shim for local testing
export REDWOOD_SDK_SHIM=enabled
# typescript
const client = new RedwoodClient({ enableProxyShim: true })
```

jia (eng): One caveat: the shim must not override an explicit header set by the user. If a request already has X-Route-Policy we skip injection. That preserves user intent.

leah (eng-platform): Also add a debug log `proxy-shim: skipped - user-set header` at debug level so platform teams can triage.

ops-bot: deploy-bot started canary: sdk-python v1.12.0-shim. 10% canary in us-west. :rocket:

maria (devex): timeline: PRs today, canary tomorrow, monitor telemetry for 48h, then open to opt-in testers. Reminder: do not flip default to on without a 2-week notice.

sam (eng-platform): I'll coordinate console tile + opt-out control. tagging @leah for the dashboard panel.

alex (devex): I'll draft the docs + migration guide. Ping me for wording.

jia (eng): I'll add the server-side acceptance window to the internal runbook and a query that finds clients still sending legacy header.

maria (devex): perfect — thanks all. :thumbsup:
